notes.title: 125.000+ User! - What now?
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you[/h1]
Steam thought it was a good idea to place [b]Stockwrk7[/b] on the [b]New & Trending[/b] Page. ːlunar2019wavingpigː
This flooded a incredible amount of players on the game. And I would like to say Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061010/4ea7f2e421a9a5fe681e665800a3d28ecff02205.png[/img]

[h1]Two Weeks Release - In Numbers[/h1]

[b]Stockwrk7[/b] was released 18 days ago and got [b]125.674 User[/b], that pressed the "Play free!" Button. Over 28.340 People downloaded the game so far.


[h2]More numbers[/h2]
Player Regions
[list]
[*] Asia	25,175	89.2%
[*] Western Europe	1,195	4.2%
[*] Russia, Ukraine, & CIS	406	1.4%
[*] South East Asia	406	1.4%
[*] North America	357	1.2%
[*] Eastern Europe	283	1.0%
[*] Latin America	176	0.6%
[*] Middle East	136	0.4%
[*] South Asia	49	0.1%
[*] Oceania	22	0.0%
[*] Africa	17	0.0%
[/list]
Daily User
[list]
[*] Average daily active users		279		
[*] Maximum daily active users		8,379		
[*] Average daily Steam Deck users		0		
[*] Maximum daily Steam Deck users		2	
[/list]

[h1]60% Review Rating? - What's wrong?[/h1]
At this moment there are 68 reviews. 44 Reviews are ːsteamthumbsupː and 24 ːsteamthumbsdownː
But what's wrong?

Five (5) negative Reviews are german. 
Another five (5) are englisch.
Over 14 negative Reviews are russian, chinese or korean.

Most of the Reviews are complain about the language ([b]german only[/b]) and/or poor performance. Maybe i gave to little hints about the language?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43061010/365ae827ebf4df898d867e75cba780c28f7a110e.png[/img]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/A928XcIImHJAc/giphy.gif?cid=ecf05e472qr4b7rf76nne679es2jepgtn1k780o9gsfmmclw&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

Steam forces me always to release all informations in Englisch as well. This sucks ːsteamfacepalmː because the game was never intended to be played by non-germans. And I'm really sorry that the game does not have a english translation. But that's not just some simple Clicky-Clacky Action for me. A proper translation, integration cost resources that wasn't planned at all. This is a hobby fun project. So please.. Don't give a negative review, because it doesn't support english.

[h1]And now? What's next?[/h1]

A lot of people gave me a very positive review on [url=https://discord.gudeandi.de]Discord [/url]and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/gudeandi]Twitch [/url] and encourage me to do a new game. But currently i'm not sure in which Direction I would like to go. My current plan is to improve my skills till 2023. And we'll see what happens. But if it would be a game, it will receive a proper englisch translation.ːsteamhappyː
If you're interested in my stuff you can [url=https://gudeandi.de]follow me on my socials[/url].


[h2]HOLD ON... What comes for Stockwrk7?[/h2]

Nothing. No Game Breaking Bugs are reported. The Game keeps it state. 

That's why I only have one final word: Thank you and have fun with the game!

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/3o7qDEq2bMbcbPRQ2c/giphy.gif?cid=ecf05e4780da0dlzx49wf7qaj1p2u9wky8s4p14k1xoq0ssi&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

notes.title: Final Release + Hardware Anforderungen
notes.notes:
[h1]Release[/h1]
After 23 Hours more than 2000 Players added the Game to their Library and over 200 Players already played it.

[h1]Hardwarerequirements[/h1]
Don't try to play this small game with low graphic card. AT LEAST A GTX 1080 is necessary!
